reason: Two official value-free source-audit runs showed that both the logged action support and the archived item-context catalog can differ from the published 0..80 range. The archive must therefore be treated as the executable source of truth for catalog/support, while published ranges remain comparison metadata.

contract.catalog: derive exact item IDs from the archived item_context.csv files and require BTS and Random catalogs to agree exactly
contract.logged_support: require each behavior-policy logged action set to be a non-empty subset of its archived item-context catalog
contract.published_range: retain documented 0..80 / 81-action claim as comparison metadata only; do not force it onto the archive
contract.target_policy: do not modify the preregistered target policy until the exact archive catalog and logged support have been frozen and identifiability assessed

outcome_visibility: No click count, CTR, reward mean, OPE estimate, challenger value, policy ranking, or promotion result was inspected to make this amendment.
